meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 11 — Ethnic minorities and northern mountainous regions densification: demographic and poverty concentration, regional profile, and ethnic-policy framing.

candidates.title: Ethnic minority population and composition statistics
candidates.description: Official statistics on Vietnam’s 54 ethnic groups. The Kinh majority forms the large bulk of the population; ethnic minorities (approximately 15 % of the total) are concentrated especially in the Midlands and Northern Mountains and the Central Highlands.
candidates.notes: Core demographic node for ethnic composition.

candidates.title: Midlands and Northern Mountains regional profile
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO regional and poverty sources
candidates.description: System-level view of the Midlands and Northern Mountains — the region with the highest concentration of ethnic minorities and persistently higher poverty rates. Accounts for a disproportionate share of national poverty relative to its population.
referenced_by: National accounts and regional disparity analysis
candidates.notes: Key lagging-region spatial node that contrasts with the Red River Delta and Southeast growth poles.

candidates.title: Ethnic minority poverty and living-standards statistics
candidates.publisher: GSO / World Bank-aligned and national poverty monitoring
candidates.description: Poverty rates and living-standards indicators disaggregated by ethnicity. Ethnic minorities account for a large majority of remaining poverty despite representing a minority of the population; absolute numbers of poor ethnic minorities have fallen substantially over the past decade.

candidates.title: Ethnic minority and mountainous-region development policy framing
candidates.publisher: Party-State / Ministry of Ethnic and Religious Affairs related
candidates.description: National policy framing and target programmes for socio-economic development in ethnic minority and mountainous regions (including the National Target Programme 2021–2030). Continuously cited in poverty-reduction and regional-equity discussions.
referenced_by: Ethnic poverty and Northern Mountains nodes
candidates.notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the ethnic and regional statistical nodes.

candidates.title: Vietnam ethnic–northern-mountains densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO, poverty and ethnic-policy sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding ethnic minority population and composition, Midlands and Northern Mountains regional profile, ethnic minority poverty statistics, and ethnic-policy / mountainous-region development framing into a coherent equity and lagging-region layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier poverty, regional and social-protection series
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the ethnic and northern-mountains densification pass.
